scientific_role: pre-outcome representation feasibility only; not selector confirmation

source_ready_lane.input: full family-specific coarse evidence order from the active v2 endpoint
source_ready_lane.retained_rule: retain exactly ceil(0.025 * source_ready_candidate_count) highest-ranked source-ready candidates
source_ready_lane.tie_rule: coarse order is already total and deterministic; no new score tie is resolved here
source_ready_lane.aggregation: within each regional_tile_id, deterministic complete-link aggregation at maximum within-patch distance 1000 m

source_indeterminate_lane.reason: no ecological rank exists and recoding missing-source candidates into the 2.5% source-ready tier would be invalid

feasibility_endpoints.primary: number of non-ranked bounded patches after 1-km aggregation

interpretation.if_compression_is_weak: the validated robust constants do not solve fresh coarse-to-compact representation because the coarse lattice is too sparse; do not change the constants post hoc
interpretation.if_compression_is_strong: representation feasibility only; a separate untouched recovery/field validation is still required before calling the transferred tier a fresh-SENTINEL selector

forbidden: do not tune the 1-km merge distance
do not use CIR02/CIR06/CIR12/CIR13 field outcomes
do not add a Top-k or target patch count
do not call this validated robust support because the score semantics differ
